reviews.text:
Leaving 1 star because there is nothing less. My wife and so e took our cat last night for urinary blockage and they gave them a quote of $7,500! for 3 days stay plus whatever the surgery would be. Was told Surgery could be around $6,000 to $8,000 dollars. Wife asked them how much to keep the cat till the morning and they said $2,500! For a few hours. Took the cat and is getting the surgery this afternoon for $7,000 with 3 days of recovery.
Should have known better after going there about 12 yrs earlier for a German shepherd i had and it was super expensive then. NEVER EVER GOING BACK AND WILL ADVISE TO DO THE SAME TO ALL.
Maria and Kattie are excellent people with outstanding service.

Took our 16yr cat for the 1st time. Immediately greeted and after a brief assessment I was taken to a private room. The place is spotless, super neat everywhere. Hailey, the nurse was friendly, thorough, and empathetic. Dr Daniel Bonce was equally pleasant, explained the issues, what to expect, and possible outcomes. It was a UTI infection. Left the cat for several hours for hydration and labs. She was treated with such kindness. This place rocks!  And it’s 24/7 !!!  What a keeper.

DO NOT waste your time or money at this veterinary clinic.

I arrived with my cat struggling to breathe. They immediately put him on oxygen while they performed the physical examination and supposedly worked on a diagnosis. Then they took my cat to an area where I was not allowed to see him, and for THREE HOURS, no one gave me any updates.

I asked SIX different times what was happening, and every time I was told to wait because they were going through a shift change.

When the doctor finally came out, she gave me a list of tests and procedures, with the cheapest option costing around $9,000. And that’s not even mentioning the nearly $500 they charged me for the three hours of oxygen, which apparently was part of their “shift change” process.

I do want to mention that the reception staff were kind and professional, and Anthony, the veterinary nurse, was also very kind and helpful. My negative experience is not directed at them personally.

However, the overall handling of my cat’s emergency was extremely disappointing. Obviously, we left and went to VEG, which was only 12 minutes away. The treatment and communication were COMPLETELY DIFFERENT. They actually took the time to communicate with me and properly address my cat’s condition.

I strongly recommend thinking twice before bringing your pet here. Don’t waste precious time that could make a difference in your pet’s life at a place where you feel like money comes before your animal’s well-being.
I called saying I’d pick up my dog between 4 and 5 they said they’d have him ready, got there closer to 5 and waited over an hour.
We're thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us.

I don’t know why they advertise themselves as emergency or having surgeons. The receptionist on the phone told me it would take a week to get a consultation for my dogs broken paw. They don’t care about animals at all
The staff and Dr. Lin were wonderful during my 1st visit to Thrive for a consultation. They were thorough in explaining the procedure for my little furry kitten, Mighty Tom. Highly recommended!

Every member of the Thrive team that we interacted with was educated, helpful, caring, supportive and kind.  Our visit was very difficult and the outcome wasn’t what we expected but they walked us through everything.  I am very grateful and appreciative for the support and compassion for our beloved dog and our family.

The staff here (Vianca and Maria today) is very warm, caring and responsive. Dr Hatfield is an absolute superhero. I came here this morning with my 13 year old
Maltese in respiratory distress and heart failure. I didn’t know if she’d be coming home. They diagnosed the problem and formulated and executed a plan of action fast and effectively. She’s going to have to stay overnight so I’ll update when she’s ready to come home but light years better than this morning. I wholeheartedly recommend this place if you have a pet emergency
UPDATE my girl is home with me and safe. The staff I mentioned above were amazing, but so was every single additional person that helped me. The doctors, nurses, techs, reception, everyone.  I can’t thank them enough or recommend them higher.

We have been with Dr. Patrick and her amazing team since 2023, and we couldn’t be more grateful for the care they have provided to our dog, Nahia.

Nahia had struggled with elevated liver enzymes from a young age, with her levels constantly going up and down. We originally discovered this clinic when she needed surgery for a leg injury, and later decided to get an internal medicine consultation for her liver issues. From that point forward, Dr. Patrick and her team took over her care, and we have never looked back.

Over the years, Nahia has had a few other health issues, and this team has always been there, making sure she receives the right care and that we understand everything along the way.

We are truly grateful to Dr. Patrick and her entire team for everything they have done for Nahia. We highly recommend them to anyone looking for exceptional, compassionate care for their pet. ❤️🐾

They’re the best ,
Dr Rebeca Linn is the best orthopedic surgeon!
The staff is amazing!! Thanks 🙏🏻 …
Thank you for the 5-star rating. Your trust in our team means a great deal to us.

Took my dog in for a dog bite and was given great attention. From Jose at the front desk to Mackenzie being super sweet with my baby. It really helped the visit go smooth. Dr.Bonce came and explained everything  they were going to do to him and answered any questions we had. Definitely a great experience.

Terrible experience. Would NOT recommend. Was there for 4 hours. Charged 1,300 for X-rays and fluids. Was told my dog needed surgery to remove something that was potentially in her stomach based on the X-rays which were not clear. The price for the surgery was $10,900 and that was without any hard evidence of what was in her stomach. No bloodwork no ultrasound. Nothing. Turns out I left and took her to my vet in the morning. She fed her and she monitored her for 3 hours. Gave me meds for nausea and she pooped out whatever was bothering her and was fine. For $90.

Had to bring my 6 year old pomsky dog due to her swallowing a piece of fabric/soft toy
Up that wasn’t even hers. The vet we usually take her to was closed. Since it was around 8 PM on a Friday, they referred us to Thrive. They were able to help us without surgical intervention in a very efficient manner. The service was great and all the technicians and staff were very caring. It was also a very clean facility and I believe the pricing for their services was reasonable considering the location. I would definitely bring her back if needed for any emergencies. Recommend 1000%.

Thank you Thrive

The truth is, Anthony and the doctor who treated me provided excellent care. I arrived with my dog ​​intoxicated after leaving another emergency room due to the poor treatment I received. I truly appreciate the good service offered by the clinic.

My dog, Rylee, was admitted in critical condition. Thrive nursed her back to stable condition and released her with new meds. Juan, Maria and the rest of the staff were always responsive when calling with questions. I am truly thankful.

I am so grateful for the dedication and attention with which Miss Bianca and Miss Anette welcomed me and treated me so well. I feel very confident 😃 that I went to Thrive Hospital. Thank you so much 🤗🤗 …

I am very pleased with  the entire staff both those who welcomed me and the technical team
Jose R
Jose J
Dr Hatfield
We apologize for your experience. Please contact us at (305) 666-4142 so we can address your concerns directly.
Jose J in reception was very caring and very professional he helped my wife while our dog was there he took passion and you could tell he loves what he does

Thank you everyone for helping me with my baby I was extremely worried for my little baby you guys were amazing and very helpful also thank you jose J in reception for being so nice and getting me in as quick as you did
Wonderful Dr. Patrick and her Team getting my Molly well ! So grateful !
Thank you for your help, excellent service, and thank you to Dr. Cochiran.
caring team of vets and nurses. your pet is in good hands

the receptionist jose j in the front desk was very polite and helpful when I came in to get my dog a check up, he explain the every step I need to do in details so that I can get my do an appointment as soon as possible very happy with the interaction

I brought my pup in for a lower lip avulsion. This was not life threatening, but did require prompt treatment. The vet tech that attended to us, Anthony, was so great. He really took his time in explaining everything, answering all our questions, and even demonstrating how to administer meds. His diligence made all the difference in terms of my comfort and confidence in a sudden and unforeseen procedure taking place.

I have now had 2 encounters with this facility and unfortunately had 2 pretty bad experiences. I was told to euthanize my dog because treatment was “very expensive” & the outcome wasn’t guaranteed. Of course I know no outcome is ever guaranteed in medicine. But shouldn’t we try before just jumping to euthanasia? Then, upon further discussion, the vet tells me that if we were to proceed with the “expensive treatment” (TPE for ITP) that they weren’t equipped to perform the procedure anyhow. (For context, my dog was bleeding out and had 0 platelets due to ITP)

I wish instead of wasting time during a true emergency & discussing an “expensive treatment” that they weren’t even able to perform, that they would have just referred me to a higher intensive care hospital that WOULD be able to perform TPE, should we decide to follow through with it.

Another CCU Specialty hospital in Boca Raton saved my dog, administered 3 days of TPE, & my dog is still with me today. No euthanasia. & more importantly, no projection of their judgement on me and my boyfriend as a young couple that we “may not be able to afford it.”

I left feeling as I only wasted time in the midst of a true emergency.

OMG Dr Rebeca Lín and staff are the best ,
Very professionals. I recommend them 100%

He made the whole experience so much less stressful with his positive attitude and professionalism. You can tell he truly cares about the people and pets who come through the door. Thank you, Jose, for going above and beyond. You made a lasting impression, and Thrive Pet Healthcare is lucky to have you!
We are glad to hear your experience with us was positive. Your support means a lot to our team.
Jose J and Vianka were both very professional, and friendly. They are a great example of amazing employees. Thank you so much!
My recent Visit was Amazing, especially with the receptionist Jose. He was a cool guy, extremely helpful and didn’t hold back on any information needed. 10/10 would come back again.

How this place has anything less than 5 stars is beyond me. Professionalism is merely the baseline; the staff actually cares. The nurses and doctors were beyond kind, empathetic, and sincere. We were given regular checkups via text and phone every couple of hours. For a very traumatic experience with our dog, we could not have felt more comfortable throughout the entire process and left that office each time knowing that our pup was in the best of hands. They even let us stop in during an overnight to say hello to our little guy. If you want to feel comfortable, knowing the people handling your pet will treat them as if they were their own, go to Thrive and don't second guess it. Dr. Lin and Patricia were the absolute best. Thanks to Jose at the front desk as well.

Bianca answered the call with complete calmness as I was dealing with a traumatic event with my fur baby. When we arrived she came outside to help us in. Amazing woman that is, and will continue, doing great things for all! 2 points on the board-give her 100.
* I spoke with Jose J. for a follow up and he was great too, 1 point ;)

My dog was seen at Thrive a few days ago for unexpected vomiting. Bianca the receptionist was great from the phone to the check out process. Thank you Dr. Persaud and Dr. Silva for seeing my baby and taking care of him!
receptionist jose j in the front desk was very helpful and kind
Very friendly and helpful staff. They made me feel at ease during the situation with my dog. Thank you, Bianca, for all your help and support. I truly appreciate everything you did.

My experience here was great !!!! Took my dog Sparky with my son not long ago. When we went he was scared and worried the gentleman at the front desk I believe his name was Jose J saw my sons face and reassured him that sparky was in good hands and that he would be ok. My son went from worrying to be calm. As a parent I couldn’t ask for more. Sparky was ok and my son left happy thank you all for the wonderful service.
Awesome service especially from jose. Very welcoming and good staff.
Great place. Jose J at the front was very supportive, and just amazing to my fur baby. Made the visit a lot less stressful. Kudos!

My husband took our baby in and I can’t say enough good things about this veterinary clinic. From the moment we walked in, the receptionist Jose was kind, patient, and genuinely caring toward our baby . The vet  Dr.Persaud took the time to explain everything clearly, answered all my questions, and made sure our baby  was comfortable the entire visit. You can truly tell they love animals and treat them like family. The clinic is clean, well-organized, and welcoming.  Highly recommend Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists
The staff here is amazing. Felt like family. Jose at the front made a stressful situation feel better.
Reiner,Jose and Dr Huerta were awesome.  Check in was smooth, Rey was very patient and was able to explain everything.  Dr Huerta was very understanding and worked with us! definitely recommend!

The guy at the front desk Jose J was very kind, welcoming, and genuinely cared about both me and my pet. He was very patient in answering my questions, kept me informed, and made the entire visit smooth and stress-free. Their compassion and professionalism really stood out. Thank you for making such a positive difference!
Thanks to Lázaro and José J, they are excellent professionals, and Dr. Persaud.
Took my dog in late last night because he wasn’t doing well Bianca was very professional and got me seen as soon as possible. Thank you Bianca for all you did!
Honestly Thrive has one of the friendliest and knowledgeable specialist in south miami. Highky recommend for your pets care!
Jose J. in reception was very caring and compassionate. I was so scared when I came in with my fur baby, and he made my entire experience much better. Thank you for everything you did for us.

Difficult day with our cat. The staff - Dr Huerta and Bianca at the front desk were extremely professional, courteous and attentive as we received service, prognosis and preparation for our pet’s end of life treatment. Clean facility and top quality care. Highly recommend the practice for 24/7 emergency care.

Front Desk personal was amazing and scheduled drop off and pickup perfectly. The Vet wasn't very personal but professional but mainly saved our dog. Cost is high because it is a ER vet so no complains here.

The team at Thrive always provides the best care for my pet. Bianca at the front desk is great. She was warm and welcoming when we arrived and was helpful through the appointment. We are so grateful for the care Dr. Huerta and Dr. Parker provided.

I am grateful for every person that works here. Specially Dr. Patrick, Jaslean, Cynthia, Yani, and all the staff that has taken care of my dog. We brought her here a couple of years ago with a really rare condition that Dr. Patrick researched and treated and saved my dog. Since then she is on life long meds and any time she needs care she’s been taken care of in the best way possible. The only complaint I have is a relief doctor that was here on a Sunday that did not help my dog, but thankfully on Monday I was told to come back to see Dr. Huerta who is also amazing and I wasn’t  charged a fee and the appropriate treatments were done. I am eternally grateful for everyone here and recommend this place 100%.

I had a great experience at Thrive. The staff was professional, caring, and made a stressful visit with my cat much easier. Sara at the front desk was especially kind and welcoming, and I really appreciated her help. Thank you to the entire team for the excellent care and service

My furbaby Maxx was referred here for surgery after he was detected a tumor near his back leg.  I'm so grateful for this wonderful staff that has helped my furbaby, my family and myself during this difficult time. Thank you Bianca, Maria, Kylie, Sara,  Kiara, Alyssa, Patricia, Juan, Dr.Huerta, Dr. Lin and the whole staff,  I'm slowly learning all their names since we've gotten to interact with all of them at one point lol,  they've helped us very much. The staff all have such love and care for the animals that come in thru the hospital doors.  Thank youfor helping us from Maxx's first visit and thank you for continue helping us during his recovery. Thank you all!! :)
The veterinarian and staff are nice, attentive and informative for the care of your pet. They saved one of my cats that was anemic with a transfusion and excellent care last Christmastime.

I had the unfortunate experience of my dog suddenly passing away (not due to the care here). I brought him to Thrive to process his remains and Sara was incredibly sensitive and helpful. I’m so grateful to her kind demeanor and ability to help with care during an incredibly difficult time.

I can’t thank everyone at Thrive Pet Healthcare enough for everything they did for my dog. She was transferred there with an advanced case of ITP, and I was absolutely terrified. From the moment we walked in, everyone treated us with so much kindness, compassion, and respect that I immediately knew she was in the right place.

A huge thank you to Bianca and Maria at the front desk. They were so welcoming, attentive, and genuinely caring from the second we arrived. During such a stressful time, they made me feel comfortable and at home, and that meant more than they probably realize.

I also want to recognize the amazing nurses, Jesline, Rey, and Kathy. They took such wonderful care of my dog and were always kind, compassionate, and reassuring. You can tell they truly love what they do and care deeply about every patient they treat.

Dr. Fiat and Dr. Huerta deserve my deepest gratitude. Their knowledge, attention to detail, and genuine concern for my dog’s well-being were incredible. They didn’t just treat her—they took the time to thoroughly explain what was happening with her ITP, discuss the treatment plan, answer all of my questions, and make sure I understood every step moving forward. Their communication and compassion gave me hope during one of the hardest moments I’ve experienced as a pet owner.

Another thing that really stood out was their honesty and fair pricing. At no point did I feel like I was being pushed into unnecessary tests or treatments. They were transparent, compassionate, and focused on what was truly best for my dog.

Everyone at Thrive made us feel like family, and that’s something I’ll never forget. I know we still have a long road ahead with my dog’s ITP, but I’m so thankful she was placed in the hands of such an incredible team.

Thank you, Bianca, Maria, Jesline, Rey, Kathy, Dr. Fiat, and Dr. Huerta, for treating my dog with so much love and for treating me with so much kindness during such a difficult time. I would recommend Thrive Pet Healthcare without hesitation to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care.

Many thanks to Dr. Patrick and Jeslean from the Internal Medicine team, my golden retriever survived a DKA episode that required 11 total days of hospitalization between two veterinary clinics. Although Thrive’s prices are quite high and the financial system can be confusing, I am very grateful for the IM team’s care, guidance, and support as we navigate our dog’s diabetes and continue adjusting her medication to meet her changing needs.

A special thank-you to Cynthia and Rey for being compassionate, helpful, and truly wonderful throughout this process. Several other technicians have also been excellent.

Unfortunately, my experience with some of the front desk staff has not been as positive. In particular, I believe team members such as Alyssa would benefit from additional training in active listening and client communication. During stressful or emergency situations, it is especially important for clients to feel heard and supported before staff respond or make assumptions. A lack of attentiveness and compassion can make an already difficult situation feel even more overwhelming.

Overall, I am deeply thankful for the medical care my dog received from the Internal Medicine team, but I hope Thrive takes steps to improve the consistency, professionalism, and empathy of its front desk and phone communication.

Awesome is how I describe Thrive Pet healthcare and emergency. The numerous times I’ve had to use their services I’ve been very satisfied. I especially have to commend vet tech “Liah” who has been kind, caring, and loving in many of my pets emergencies along with regular vet care. Her compassion experience and professionalism show her character. Her experience gives me comfort in knowing that we are getting the best care. Thankyou Liah and thankyou Thrive!

If you like a Vet that will treat you and your pet similar to an auto repair; IE Here is a list of parts and procedures and the cost for each plus labor you'll love it.  If you want caring quality care run away and look elsewhere.  Very hard to write this but they asked for my review after our beloved dog passed away last night, so you can see they are quite sensitive as well.

Great staff ,   Thank you Dr. Patrick and Dr. Huerta for helping Ziggy .    Many thanks to Brian, Bianca , and Sara for assisting me with all matters for Ziggy .   You are all awesome . I am sure I am missing g some names .   Thrive was great .
Over $10,000 to perform surgery, cat aspirated and proceeded to pass away. I think of Toby every day and regret taking him there.,

My little man, Cooper—an almost 10-year-old black Labrador—loves visiting Thrive! Every few months he sees Dr. Patrick for his internal medicine checkup following his splenectomy in 2024.

From the moment we walk in, everyone is warm, welcoming, and genuinely caring. Cooper especially looks forward to saying hello to Bianca and Maria at the front desk! Dr. Patrick is exceptionally thorough, takes the time to explain every finding, and always discusses the treatment plan in detail so I leave feeling informed and confident in Cooper’s care.

I couldn’t ask for a better team to care for my best friend. I highly recommend Thrive to anyone looking for compassionate, knowledgeable veterinary care.

Saved my fur baby. He ate a can of tuna , literally the can and had pieces of metal in his stomach. Very communicative in every aspect from procedure to pricing. The staff were very sweet and compassionate. I also found the price to be reasonable for the procedure and saving my dog. I would definitely recommend Thrive!

A First Class Operation.
I’d like to recognize Cynthia Lopez. Five years ago, she helped save our cat “Baby”. She was gravely ill and thanks to her expertise and guidance, telling us that she needed to come to the ER immediately,
she received the care she needed. Cynthia took amazing care of Baby for two weeks at the ICU. Baby has been cancer-free and continues to light up and warm our home. We also continue to bring her to the internal medicine department for follow-ups.
Kudos to the entire staff as well, particularly Dr.Patrick.  She is the consummate professional; knowledgeable, personal and caring.
We wholeheartedly recommend Thrive Pet Healthcare for all your pets needs.
Your positive feedback is greatly appreciated. Thank you for choosing Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami.

I found Thrive after-hours and brought my yorkie who was vomiting and defecating blood nonstop. They were  able to stabilize and cared for her with so much love. Theres plenty of parking, their prices are reasonable  and the place is clean. Thank you to  Dr. Robaul, Liah and Lidia for their help, kindness and love with my yorkie Pepper.
Thank you for your feedback. We are thrilled to hear about your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami.
We're overjoyed to hear about your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami. Thank you immensely for your feedback, Nicki!

We came to Thrive in the middle of the night as our dog was vomiting non stop after a spay surgery. They took good care of her and found the issue quickly (which was not related to the spay). I will go back again in the future.

Bianca and Jose, Annette and Dr Robual, Md, the night time team, are awesome! They gave us prompt and courteous attention. We felt very cared for regarding our Teddy’s health concerns during our late night visit. Your office team rocks! High five everybody!

They took care of my dog. The team was very nice. Dr. Thomas, Liah, and Cynthia explained everything and were honest about  the wait time. The only downside is that was there after hours for an emergency and it was pricey, but I expected that from a 24/7 animal hospital.

Liah is the best ICU nurse!!! I know my pets are in good hands when she is there. My toy poodle was in the ICU for a few days and she made sure she wasn’t scared and was comforted at all times. She took measures beyond what any other nurse would do to keep her and us at ease.
Liah is the most caring person we have ever met. She has taken care of our dog on multiple occasions and I would trust her anytime.
Thank you for reaching out. We deeply cherish your positive feedback.
Kathy was kind, compassionate, and very thorough. She took the time to help us understand everything. Thank you for such excellent care!

Great experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare! Dr. Huertas was knowledgeable and caring, and Sara was so kind and helpful throughout the visit. You can tell they truly care about the pets they treat. Highly recommend!

I can’t thank Thrive Pet Healthcare enough for taking such amazing care of my dachshund puppy when he was sick. From the moment we walked in, the team was kind, attentive, and truly compassionate.
A special thank you to Sara, Lia, and Alyssa for being so gentle and reassuring, and to Dr. Persaud for providing such excellent care and professionalism. They took the time to explain everything and made sure my puppy was comfortable every step of the way.
Thanks to them, he is now happy, healthy, and back to his playful self. I’m so grateful for the incredible care we received—highly recommend Thrive Pet Healthcare to anyone looking for a team that truly cares about your pets!
Fast and responsive

Dr Patrick and the staff at Thrive were absolutely amazing! They were gentle, caring and explained everything in detail during my visit! I highly recommend Dr Patrick and the staff at Thrive for any emergency or specialty care that your pet may need!
Excellent care of my 2 whippets!! 🐶🐶🙂 …
Good treatment!
Thank you for your review - we're glad to hear about your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami!
Vianka and Sara are great at the front desk!!! They are so polite, helpful, and full of energy!

came to Thrive Animal Hospital because my dog, Mimosa, was having vomiting and diarrhea. We were greeted by Vianka, and she was very sweet, helpful, and made sure we had everything we needed. They took Mimosa to the back, ran some tests, and let us know she had gastroenteritis. Before we left, they gave her a few shots and sent us home with medication. Mimosa is all better now, and I’m very thankful for their care.
Thrive Miami treated my pet with great compassion and care in her last moments. A big thank you to Dr.huerta and Yami.
We're delighted to hear about your positive experience at Thrive Pet Healthcare Specialists Miami. Thank you for sharing your feedback with us!

In late February, my 4-month-old Mini Australian Labradoodle, Hamm, came to Thrive in a critical emergency after sustaining serious injuries while in someone else’s care. From the moment we walked in, the team met us with urgency, compassion, and complete professionalism. They let my boyfriend and I (Hamm’s parents) visit at all hours while they worked to stabilize her — because they understood that as her parents, we needed to be close, and they never once made us feel like a burden for it. That level of humanity during one of the scariest moments of our lives meant everything.

The surgery team has been nothing short of phenomenal. Their communication throughout the entire process — from diagnosis to surgery to recovery — has been thorough, honest, and genuinely caring. They don’t treat Hamm like a case number. They treat her like they love her, and honestly, it shows. Every follow-up, every check-in, every time we’ve had a question or concern, they’ve shown up. They’ve gone out of their way to see her in a timely manner, to make sure her healing is progressing, and to approach her recovery holistically rather than just checking boxes. The reception team is kind and caring. They get to know the clients. They’re warm and inviting even in our hardest times.

I’m posting this in late April because Hamm’s care is still ongoing. And through this ongoing care, the Thrive team has continued to impress us at every turn. Thrive didn’t just save Hamm’s life — they’ve walked alongside us through an incredibly difficult road with warmth, expertise, and genuine dedication. If you are looking for a team that will treat your pet like family, look no further.
